sql: SELECT 'mov_tip' AS col, mov_tip::text AS val, count(*) FROM legado.movinv GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'mov_alm', mov_alm::text, count(*) FROM legado.movinv GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'mov_uni', mov_uni, count(*) FROM legado.movinv GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'mov_qty_max_min', max(mov_qty)::text || ' / ' || min(mov_qty)::text, count(*) FROM legado.movinv ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT mov_id, mov_art, mov_alm, mov_tip, mov_qty, mov_uni, mov_fch, mov_usr FROM legado.movinv WHERE mov_alm IS NULL OR mov_alm = 7 OR mov_art IS NULL OR mov_uni IS NULL ORDER BY mov_id
